artwork_grid_photo_fit.observation: Four regular rows of eight historical midpoints were measured, but native package registration shows they follow DRAM top contacts rather than independent capacitor pairs. The .006 labels C63 at row two/column six and C69 at row four/column eight in the model, but these photographed midpoints do not prove their capacitor holes. artwork_grid_photo_fit.registered_feature_identity: four DRAM package top-contact rows, with each historical grid x midpoint between adjacent package contacts; not an independent capacitor-pad census
artwork_grid_photo_fit.four_row_package_alignment: The historical observed row centers y=[631.5,760.3,890.4,1021.0] px in solder_grid-rectified.jpg coincide with the visible top-contact rows of the four DRAM banks at approximately y=[633,761,890,1019] px. The x centers repeat at DRAM package pitch; the first center (579.9,631.5) matches the D67.16/D66.1 midpoint (581.02,632.74). Thus the regular 4x8 observations classify package contacts, not 32 independent capacitor landing pairs.
artwork_grid_photo_fit.c35_native_solder_screen: The current PCB C35 5.00 mm pair lies 3.31 mm above D67's top row at x offsets +1.305/+6.305 mm from D67.1. The direct D67 component fit in 200411500 projects those model pads to front (2872,1699)/(2981,1699); the registered D9 component-to-solder reflection then projects them to original 200525009 solder near (2678,1415)/(2570,1415). Native crop (2400,1310)-(2850,1550) shows uninterrupted trace/bare board at both projected points, with no drill annuli. This is a negative screen for the current C35 PCB geometry, not proof that no separate C35 holes exist elsewhere on the .009 board. An overlapping owner component image 200415237 independently places the modeled holes near original (1142,1792)/(1250,1792) after the registered tile-to-tile transform; both positions are visible bare board below the white wire with no annuli. Thus both faces reject the current C35 geometry. Retain the fabrication hold and search for actual holes rather than copying the modeled pair.
artwork_grid_photo_fit.package_contact_confounder: First proposed grid midpoint (579.9,631.5) in the rectified solder image is within about 1.7 px of the midpoint (581.02,632.74) of independently registered D67.16 and D66.1 package contacts. Their two rails are GND and RAIL_H in the source model, whereas C35 is modeled across RAIL_G and GND. The observed 4x8 regularity therefore cannot prove independent optional capacitor pairs. Inspect each site in native component and solder photos before promoting footprint fabrication.
artwork_grid_photo_fit.fit_error_scope: The 0.35 mm residual checks spacing/linearity inside the observed 4×8 grid against the existing board-coordinate pattern. It is not an independent absolute placement error bound: the broad board-to-panorama homography is fit to four board corners, with D94 as its only held-out fiducial, and disagrees by about 16 mm in x with locally registered D9/D7. Do not derive exact C35-to-C88 clearance from it.
